note: Daily council 2026-08-07. Named to sort last in this directory (newest_request() is lexicographic, not mtime — 2026-08-05 defect, propose-only, still unfixed at session open) and checked against analytics/fetch-results/ for a name collision before firing (0 matches for 2026-08-07). THREE QUESTIONS. (1+2) A/81/17 watch, day 7 of the publication window, at the Commission Sessions posting location, in the standard same-page positive-control form: the target symbol plus a control string known present on that page (A/80/17). The undocs.org / docs.un.org symbol route stays RETIRED (2026-08-04) as carrying no existence information at the relay's reduction level. Relay nulls are about RENDERED TEXT: fetch_relay.py strips attributes, so a symbol appearing only inside an href is invisible to this channel; and the find is entity-blind, so a symbol rendered with an HTML entity or a non-ASCII solidus would also read as absent. Per 0806-B3 this is a SAMPLE POINT at one timestamp, never a continuous interval. (3) THE CONVERSE FALSE-ID CONTROL, pre-registered here before any result exists — 2026-08-06 Next Step 5, the only outstanding residual on the B7 discharge. Yesterday's control put a false SLUG on the true numeric id 978 and got back the head 'China - Switzerland BIT (2009)', which discharged B7 to database-record level on the reasoning that the title is keyed to the id. That inference has one unexcluded competitor: that the page head is generated from whatever is in the URL and yesterday's row simply had the true id supplying it. This row runs the converse — the TRUE slug on a false numeric id 999999 — and the two rows together separate the two accounts. DECISION RULE, FIXED IN ADVANCE — (a) 404, or a final_url differing from the requested URL: the id is load-bearing, the slug is not, yesterday's discharge SURVIVES and the identification residual CLOSES; (b) HTTP 200 and the excerpt head reads 'China - Switzerland BIT (2009)': the head tracks the slug irrespective of the id, yesterday's discharge was reasoning from an ambiguous datum, and B7 REOPENS at URL-slug level — the negative branch, and the one that costs us something; (c) HTTP 200 with any other head, or an ambiguous/empty excerpt: inconclusive, residual stays open, no discharge is claimed either way. This row is a control on our own method, not a discovery request; it is authorised as optional-and-unscheduled by yesterday's close-out and is taken today because it is one row and it is the last thing standing between B7 and a clean close. NOT FIRED TODAY: Huawei ARB/22/2 (ICSID) — adopted 2026-08-06 as a STANDING WEEKLY row with the next firing dated 2026-08-13, and a schedule the council set six days ago is not re-opened because the rows are cheap.
